## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false

library(reticulate)
library(dplyr)

# Point reticulate at this project's Python venv -- tested working recipe:
# use_python(..., required = TRUE) called before any other reticulate call.
use_python(file.path(getwd(), ".venv", "bin", "python"), required = TRUE)

# import_from_path(), not manual sys.path$insert() -- tested gotcha: reticulate
# auto-converts sys$path to a plain R character vector, so $insert() on it
# fails with "$ operator is invalid for atomic vectors". import_from_path()
# is the idiomatic reticulate way to import a module from a non-package
# directory without touching sys.path directly.
dh <- import_from_path("databricks_helpers", path = file.path(getwd(), "scripts"))

df_py <- dh$load_waiting_list()
RTT_THRESHOLD <- dh$RTT_THRESHOLD

# Tested working conversion (see AI instructions above for why this path,
# not $to_pandas(), is used):
df <- as.data.frame(py_to_r(df_py$to_dict(as_series = FALSE)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: preview

head(df)
```
